name: reset_investigation
description: Explicitly clear all retained Evidence and Unknown revision history, including engine replay/source bindings, while keeping a healthy active engine open. Drain earlier admitted work and queue later requests. Optional save_path writes the complete canonical Evidence bundle with file sync and atomic publication before clearing; import_evidence_bundle restores its original IDs and Unknown history in another process. Cancellation, save failure or incomplete cleanup preserves records; a published checkpoint remains reported on a later failure. Without save_path this discards in-memory records. No automatic persistence or eviction occurs; binary_session reports the representation budget.
